basis: Explicit rule-by-rule normative/project assessment; neither ili2c acceptance nor a failed current compile automatically changes the profile.

reference.textProfile: Strict per-file explicit decoding; original source bytes retained unchanged.

rules.decision: Existing explicit user decision: references to NO OID classes remain forbidden.
Explicit user decision: outer type names stay reserved in nested scopes.
Explicit user decision: zero overlap is invalid; the permitted positive 2.3 small tolerance remains valid.

rules.norm: Project specification 04 E5; norm 2.3 §2.2.8.1 / 2.4 §3.2.8.1 defines comments only
rules.decision: Existing scalar metadata contract; fn.param repetition and multiline compatibility are not generalized to conflicting scalar comment/ili2db.dispName.
Malformed !!@comment STANDARDOID omits equals; literal source is rejected by the documented metadata grammar.
Mandatory structure wildcard requires concrete allowed values or an abstract attribute; optional/concrete controls remain valid.
Explicit user decision: SET main expression has no individual object context; WHERE retains it.
Role namespace collisions remain invalid; qualified navigation and valid independent role names remain valid.

rules.norm: 2.3 §2.14 S.65–66 / 2.4 §3.14 S.84–87; declared function parameter types
rules.decision: SO_FunctionsExt.area expects OBJECTS but receives geometry; GeoW_FunctionsExt.Union expects ANYSTRUCTURE but receives an object set. Preserve assignment typing; individual objects as structures and singleton object-to-set compatibility remain allowed.
Explicit user decision: continuous subdivision requires CIRCULAR.
Role and attribute namespace conflicts remain invalid; independent names and nonconflicting inheritance remain valid.
Same namespace contract in inverse declaration order; no blanket permission from ili2c acceptance.
A mandatory union attribute must exist in every basis; matching bases and optional attributes remain valid.
